## Nivyx v2.4.1

Simpler packages and one name everywhere. The DPI bypass itself is
unchanged.

**Download** the package for your system, extract it and run
**Install**:

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `nivyx-windows-x86_64.zip` | Windows 10/11 |
| `nivyx-macos-arm64.zip` | Apple silicon Macs |
| `nivyx-macos-x86_64.zip` | Intel Macs |
| `nivyx-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Linux (Debian 12, Ubuntu 22.04 and newer) |

### Changes
- Every package now has just **Install**, **Update**, **Uninstall**, the
  `nivyx` command and a short `QUICKSTART.txt`; everything else is in a
  `files` folder.
- Linux has a ready-to-install package (no compiling): `sudo ./install.sh`.
- The service, folders and engine are now called `nivyx` on every
  platform (no more `dpi-proxy`).
- A release now contains only the four packages and `SHA256SUMS`.

### Upgrading from v2.4.0 or earlier
Run the new package's **Install** (or **Update**) once: the old
installation is moved over and your settings are kept. The old version's
`nivyx update` cannot install this release; it refuses and changes
nothing. Later updates work with `nivyx update` again.
